Intelligence Bureau Opens Applications for ACIO II Tech Recruitment 2025: What Engineers Need to Know

29 Oct 2026, 11:01 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Public Services Desk · Source: sarkarikyp.com

Key takeaways Overview of the Intelligence Bureau Recruitment The Intelligence Bureau (IB) has released an official notification for the Assistant Central Intelligence Officer Grade-II/Technical (ACIO II Tech) recruitment for 2025. The agency has announced a total of 258 vacancies

Overview of the Intelligence Bureau Recruitment

The Intelligence Bureau (IB) has released an official notification for the Assistant Central Intelligence Officer Grade-II/Technical (ACIO II Tech) recruitment for 2025. The agency has announced a total of 258 vacancies aimed at qualified engineering professionals. The application process is being conducted entirely online through the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria and Qualifications

Prospective applicants must meet specific educational and age requirements outlined in the official notification to be considered eligible for the positions.

  • Age Limit: Candidates must fall within the age bracket of 18 to 27 years.
  • Educational Qualification: Applicants are required to hold a B.E. or B.Tech. degree along with a valid qualifying score in the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE).

Application Procedure and Fees

Eligible candidates can submit their applications online via the official website. The process requires applicants to review the detailed notification, fill out the online form with accurate personal and educational details, and upload scanned copies of necessary documents such as identity proof, mark sheets, and certificates. An online application fee of INR 100 is applicable. Applicants are advised to provide a valid email address and active contact number for future official communications.

Selection Process

According to the available details, the selection methodology for the ACIO II Tech recruitment includes both written examinations and interviews. Meeting the baseline eligibility criteria is mandatory prior to submitting an application.

Practical Implications and Verification

For engineers meeting the age and GATE requirements, this recruitment drive offers an opportunity within a central government security agency.

  • What is Confirmed: The total number of vacancies (258), the required educational background (B.E./B.Tech with GATE score), the age limit (18-27 years), the online application mode, and the application fee (INR 100).
  • What is Unknown: Specific category-wise reservation breakdowns, exact examination dates, and detailed syllabus guidelines are not detailed in the summary source and must be verified directly from the official notification.
  • How to Verify: Readers should independently review the official guidelines, fee structures, and submission deadlines directly on the official platform at the [Intelligence Bureau Recruitment Portal](https://sarkarikyp.com/intelligence-bureau-ib-acio-ii-tech-recruitment-2025/).
